label: Turret v5 + hood mechanisms (wider lanes)
describe: Turret v5 with its hood mechanisms (2026-11-16): one motor (flywheel + the squishy geared off it) and ONE servo through a sector gear. Every hood part turns about the flywheel axle on bearings. POLLEN hood (yellow): a latched lower half and a geared top half joined by one pin per side; NECTAR hood (blue): static side teeth on a solid support and a central tooth the same pin pushes. Changing the ball swings the POLLEN hood up over the wheel (about 1 s).
